        "number": "123",
        "street": "Main St",
        "city": "City",
        "postcode": "12345",
        "country": "Country"
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/addresses"), json=address_data, timeout=10)

        "longNum": "1234567812345678",
        "expires": "12/25",
        "ccv": "123"
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/cards"), json=card_data, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    card_id = resp.json()["id"]

    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

        "itemId": item_id,
        "quantity": 1,

        "address": get_url("user", f"/addresses/{address_id}"),
        "card": get_url("user", f"/cards/{card_id}"),
        "items": get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items")
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("orders", "/orders"), json=order_req, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

def test_carts_lifecycle():
    customer_id = "cart_user_" + "".join(random.choices(string.ascii_lowercase, k=8))
    item_id = "item_" + "".join(random.choices(string.ascii_lowercase, k=8))

    cart_item = {
        "itemId": item_id,
        "quantity": 2,
        "unitPrice": 15.5
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), json=cart_item, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    cart_item["quantity"] = 5
    resp = requests.patch(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), json=cart_item, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.delete(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.delete(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

def test_catalogue_queries():
    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    items = resp.json()
    assert len(items) > 0
    item_id = items[0]["id"]

    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", f"/catalogue/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    if "imageUrl" in items[0] and len(items[0]["imageUrl"]) > 0:
        image_url = items[0]["imageUrl"][0]
        image_name = image_url.split("/")[-1]
        resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", f"/catalogue/images/{image_name}"), timeout=10)
        assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/tags"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue/size"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
